aeo_summary: Cloverdale by Signature Global is a new-launch luxury community in Sector 71, Gurugram, offering expansive three- and four-bedroom residences from about 2,095 sq ft. It combines a clubhouse lifestyle, IGBC-led sustainability, and swift access to the Southern Peripheral Road and NH-48, with HRERA registration and transparent, escrow-backed compliance.

sections.who_is_it_for:
This is a premium, HRERA-registered residential enclave off the Southern Peripheral Road, planned as large-format apartments with a lifestyle clubhouse and curated greens. It suits end-users and investors seeking generous layouts, robust leisure facilities, and quick east–west connectivity across Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, and NH-48.

Key takeaways:
- Large homes: three- and four-bedroom apartments, starting around 2,095 sq ft.
- Lifestyle-first planning: heated pool, mini theatre, café, library, and a full-service clubhouse.
- Sustainability: IGBC-certified building with rainwater harvesting, STP, and ample landscaping.
sections.location_connectivity:
The site sits in Sector 71, just off the Southern Peripheral Road (SPR), enabling quick hops to Golf Course Extension Road, Sohna Road, and the NH-48 spine toward Delhi–Gurugram–Manesar. This micro-market is prized for commute efficiency to offices, schools, hospitals, and retail hubs.

Connectivity snapshot:

| Corridor | Approx. distance | Why it matters |
|---|---:|---|
| Southern Peripheral Road (SPR) | ≈ 1.5 km | Fast link to Golf Course Ext. Road and Sohna Road corridors |
| NH-48 (formerly NH-8) | ≈ 3 km | Express access to Cyber City, Manesar, and Delhi |

Notes: Actual travel time varies with peak-hour traffic and ongoing corridor upgrades by local authorities. Reference: GMDA’s SPR corridor planning and regional mobility framework [3].

sections.amenities_lifestyle:
The master plan is anchored by a luxury clubhouse featuring fitness, leisure, and social zones for all ages. Highlights include a heated swimming pool, indoor sports rooms, mini theatre, café/library, spa, and a seniors’ corner—balanced by a sizable green core and wellness tracks.

Amenity snapshot:

| Theme | Selected highlights |
|---|---|
| Sports & wellness | Gym, heated and main pools, tennis, badminton, basketball, cricket practice, yoga lawns, jogging/cycle track |
| Leisure & social | Clubhouse, café, mini theatre, party hall/lawn, cards and indoor games rooms, library, conference room, spa |
| Safety & convenience | 24x7 security with CCTV, fire systems with sensors, intercom/video phone, high-speed and service elevators, power backup, treated water |
| Sustainability | IGBC-certified building, rainwater harvesting, sewage treatment plant, large green areas |

These features are designed to support daily fitness, community engagement, and low-impact living.
sections.pricing_payment_notes:
Guidance suggests a premium price band in the mid-to-upper crore range for the segment, with ticket sizes roughly around INR 4.1–7.3 crore depending on configuration, floor, and view. Beyond base price, budget for GST as applicable, stamp duty/registration, club corpus, IFMS, meter charges, and parking (if not bundled).

Payment plan pointers:
- Construction-linked schedules are common in HRERA-regulated launches; seek the official plan and milestone triggers.
- Ask for unit-wise all-inclusive cost sheets to compare like-for-like across floors/stacks.

Pricing-safety note: Ensure every payment flows only into the project’s designated HRERA escrow account and matches the registered agreement for sale and stage-wise demand notices [1][2].

faq.question: Is the project registered with HRERA?
faq.answer: Yes. The project is visible as an active registration on the HRERA Gurugram portal, with a designated escrow/master collection account disclosed. Always verify the latest registration status, sanctioned plans, and timelines directly on the regulator’s site before making payments [1][2].

faq.question: What configurations and sizes are available?
faq.answer: Spacious three- and four-bedroom residences are planned, with sizes starting around 2,095 sq ft. Ask for unit-wise carpet/super area statements, stack plans, and detailed floor plates to match your layout preferences.

faq.question: When is possession expected?
faq.answer: As a new launch, possession will follow the schedule filed on the HRERA page and the Agreement for Sale. Review the regulator’s timeline and construction progress updates before finalizing your payment plan [1].

faq.question: Which amenities are included?
faq.answer: A full-service clubhouse with a heated pool, gym, indoor sports, mini theatre, café/library, spa, party spaces, and senior citizen areas—plus outdoor courts, jogging/cycle tracks, and kids’ play zones. Security, STP, RWH, and IGBC certification anchor sustainability and safety.

faq.question: Is there covered parking and power backup?
faq.answer: Yes. The design provides power backup and lift banks with service elevators; covered parking allocation and charges vary by unit. Confirm bay assignment, EV readiness, and any additional parking cost with the sales team.

faq.question: What is the booking amount and payment plan?
faq.answer: Booking amounts and stage-wise schedules are detailed in the official cost sheet and demand schedule. Many NCR launches follow construction-linked plans under HRERA, but confirm the exact percentage triggers and due dates for your unit.

faq.question: Are home loans available?
faq.answer: Most leading lenders typically empanel HRERA-registered projects. Check sanction status, CLSS/regular loan eligibility, and disbursal milestones aligned to your payment plan and HRERA stage certifications.

faq.question: Are there green or energy-saving features?
faq.answer: Yes. The building targets IGBC certification and includes rainwater harvesting, a sewage treatment plant, and generous landscaping aimed at lower lifecycle environmental impact.
